# Space Base Bits 1.0

Creator: Kay Lousberg / KayKit. Source: https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Space-Base-Bits-1.0. Release page: https://kaylousberg.itch.io/space-base-bits. Retrieved 2026-09-12.

The upstream archive is retained as upstream.zip. The addons/ directory is the unmodified extracted package. CC0 1.0 Universal is recorded in addons/kaykit_space_base_bits/Assets/LICENSE.txt. Upstream filenames, package files and license bytes were preserved during regrouping.

Runtime adaptations are registered in assets/asset_catalog.json with kaykit_ IDs. Each has its own Blender source, manifest and provenance record under blender/environment/. The inspector loads those runtime deliveries only; it never serves this package directly.
